image_description: A top-down view of a hammerhead shark swimming over a textured, greenish seabed. The shark's distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head) is clearly visible, along with its dorsal fin and pectoral fins. The body tapers towards the tail, which is partially out of frame or blurred by motion.
